property_summary: Only the owner can adjust transferability; a non-owner's adjustTransferability call reverts and the token's transferable flag stays false.
An admin's createGameItem increases the number of game items by exactly one and the new item's uri equals the provided tokenURI.
A non-admin caller's createGameItem always reverts and leaves the total number of game items unchanged.
On a freshly deployed C (no custom token URIs set), uri(tokenId) returns the base URI "https://ipfs.io/ipfs/" for every token id.
